verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents a drag-and-drop visual editor with an HTML option, 100+ mobile-friendly templates, on-brand designs generated in your colours, and dynamic personalisation of subject lines and content. Rendering correctly across email clients is not evidenced beyond 'mobile-friendly', and saving your own reusable templates is not explicit. All support comes from marketing pages. Missing for 10: cross-client rendering or preview/testing evidence, explicit saved reusable custom templates, personalization token syntax/fallback docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Quickly create engaging emails using our intuitive drag-and-drop editor
Designs that are as unique as your brand, generated automatically in your colours and styles
Dynamically personalise your subject lines and content, using data from your subscribers
Write your own HTML or use our drag and drop editor
